description.value: Namdhari's Punjabi Spice Restaurant is a 100% pure vegetarian Indian restaurant serving authentic Punjabi and Indian street food made from scratch with no frozen or highly processed ingredients. The menu spans samosas, golgappe, chaat, noodles, and freshly squeezed Indian-style juices, drawing on flavours the owners describe as 'India Wala'. The restaurant operates from two Surrey locations and accepts online orders.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, 100% pure vegetarian Indian restaurant with two Surrey locations (Newton 137th St and Scott Rd/92 Ave), consistent with OSM tags cuisine=indian and diet:vegetarian=yes. The website's 'Order Online' feature and menu structure confirm takeout availability, and multiple menu items are explicitly labelled vegetarian, vegan, and/or gluten-free. The OSM community tag lists 'Tsawwassen' but the website address is clearly Surrey (Unit 101, 9172 120th St), and the OSM name omits 'Punjabi Spice' from the full business name — both discrepancies are flagged.
concerns: OSM name is 'Namdhari's Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Namdhari's Punjabi Spice Restaurant' — the OSM record appears to use a shortened name.
OSM community tag is 'Tsawwassen' but the website address is Unit 101, 9172 120th Street, Surrey, BC — the record appears to be misattributed to Tsawwassen.

Website mentions two locations (Newton 137th St and Scott Rd/92 Ave) but does not disambiguate them with separate URLs or addresses; it is unclear which specific location this OSM node (lat 49.1348, lon -122.8430) represents.
No phone number found in either OSM tags or website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, online ordering, and a detailed menu — a useful stop for vegetarian and vegan touring cyclists in the Surrey area.
